decision.reasoning_trace: The search results were heavily cluttered with accessories (cases, covers, and cables) and outdated technology, such as an iPod dock with a 30-pin connector. While the consideration set included high-quality options like the Harman Kardon Onyx Studio 6 and the Audio Pro Addon C10 MKII, the prevalence of non-speaker items and redundant accessories made the browsing experience feel inefficient. Given that 30% of sessions typically end in no purchase, and the search feed felt low-quality for modern hardware needs, I decided not to make a purchase today.
